name: @refact/a11y
description: Accessibility Audit: finds what blocks people with disabilities on a website, where each problem comes from, and how to fix it. It does not fix.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run validate-formats && npm run seed-build && node tests/recurrence.mjs --serve && node tests/review.mjs --serve && node tests/seeded-faults/detect.mjs --serve --only F01,F05,F18,F74 && node tests/dry-submit.mjs --serve
scripts.build-criteria: python3 -I criteria/build.py criteria/criteria.base.json criteria/sources/axe/rule-descriptions.md criteria/sources/act/testcases.json criteria/criteria.json
